reviews.text:
I have used Team Texas Construction on 3 separate occasions and it's been the best experience. I got estimates from so many other places and they all tried to convince me I needed work I didn't need and gave me zero other options.
I worked with James and he was professional, super informative, and walked me through the whole process. I have recommended them to my whole family and would recommend them to everyone. Great company. Great value. Great work!
reviews.author: Ondrea Connolly

reviews.text: James and his entire crew are wonderful.  We put a roof on in 2010 on our first home and when when to storms hit our new home we called Team Texas immediately.  I highly recommend them and if we need another roof I will not hesitate to call.
